insights.title: Automatic recommendations
insights.subtitle: Rules applied to your own data for this period. No AI or external services: each suggestion explains its source.
insights.none: No alerts for this period. Suggestions will appear as orders grow.
insights.low_stock: {{count}} supply item(s) below minimum ({{names}}). Restock before the next peak hour.
insights.stock_runout: "{{name}}" will last about {{days}} day(s) at the current usage rate.
insights.cancel_rate: {{pct}}% of orders were cancelled. Check the reasons in Orders (stock, delays, payment).
insights.discount_heavy: Discounts are {{pct}}% of gross sales. Check that promotions are still profitable.
insights.revenue_drop: Sales fell {{pct}}% versus the previous comparable period.
insights.revenue_up: Sales rose {{pct}}% versus the previous comparable period.
insights.peak_hour: Peak hour: {{hour}}:00 ({{share}}% of orders). Add staff and prep supplies beforehand.
insights.slow_weekday: {{day}} is the slowest day (less than half of {{bestDay}}). A good candidate for a promotion.
insights.concentration: "{{name}}" makes up {{pct}}% of revenue. Secure its stock and consider promoting other items.
insights.unsold: {{count}} active product(s) with no sales this period ({{names}}). Review price, photo or visibility.
insights.missing_costs: Only {{pct}}% of sales have a recorded cost. Add recipes or costs to see your margin.
insights.anomaly_low: Sales on {{date}} were unusually low. Was there an outage, a holiday or an issue?
insights.aiText: These rules cover what an AI assistant would tell you at your current volume, at no cost and without sending data to third parties. See docs/IA-Y-COSTOS.md if you later want a natural-language summary.
